title: I See It
skill_description: Blend 2 sounds, read patterned sentences with CV and VC words.
author: FunBookies
summary: A repetitive pattern book using the frame 'I see the ___' to practice CV and VC word patterns.
targetPhonics: CV patterns (ma, so) and VC patterns (am, at, it) with letters M, S, A, T, O, I, L, C

reference_prompt:
9-PANEL REFERENCE SHEET for "I See It"

SUMMARY: A repetitive pattern book using the frame 'I see the ___' to practice CV and VC word patterns.

KEY SCENES TO SHOW (visual moments only):
  Panel 1: A child with binoculars looking at various animals. Warm watercolor style.
  Panel 2: A friendly cat sitting and looking at the viewer.
  Panel 3: A colorful mat on the floor.
  Panel 4: A cat sitting down on the floor.
  Panel 5: A child pointing at the cat on the mat.
  Panel 6: The cat sitting comfortably on the mat.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- CRITICAL: NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS, NO WRITING anywhere in the image
- 9 panels in 3x3 grid layout
- Consistent art style across all panels
- Pure visual storytelling - show scenes through imagery only
- REMINDER: This is a VISUAL ONLY reference sheet - absolutely no text or letters

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover of 'I See It'. Ask your child: What do you see? Point to the pictures and name things together. This book practices words like: cat, mat, sat, it.
parent_tips.during_reading: Point to each word as you read. Help your child find the cat on each page. When you see words like cat, mat, sat, it, sound them out slowly together.
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: What did the cat do? Can you find your favorite picture? Let's say some of the words together: cat, mat, sat, it.

comprehension_questions.question: Who is the main character in this story?
What happens at the very beginning of the story?
What happens in the middle of the story?
What adventure does the cat go on?
comprehension_questions.answer: A cat sat. I see it!
